purpose: Finite 32-64 source coverage pilot for 16-bit real-mode DOS C round trips. Planning data only: no cell, source, profile or phase in this file is evidence of a passing round trip, an emitted binary mechanism or a verified compiler configuration.

scope_status.admitted: required obligation bound to exactly one cell with a selected witness
scope_status.later: inventory retained from pilot.json/large.json; no cell selected it in this frozen pilot
scope_status.excluded: explicitly out of scope for this plan; reason recorded
scope_status.undecided: target-defined or extension behavior pending a compiler probe; never silently admitted

source_state.existing: source file exists in the repository and was read for this mapping
source_state.planned_not_implemented: witness proposal only; the path does not exist and must not be treated as available
source_state.generated_retained: generator-produced artifact retained by pinned hash, replayable through scripts/compiler_coverage_csmith.py

source_kind.runtime_case: linked-EXE round-trip case with an exit-code oracle
source_kind.compile_probe: compile-time target-defined behavior probe; not a runtime round trip
source_kind.generated_case: Csmith-generated runtime case; runtime helper boundary documented

oracle.exit_code_255: existing convention: 255 = pass, 1..N identifies the failing check
oracle.compile_time_assert: probe records target-defined facts at compile time; failure is loud

emitted_evidence.unverified: no compatible receipt proves the compiler emits the desired mechanism
emitted_evidence.verified: COD/IR/EXE inspection under the exact selected compiler/model proves emission

config_evidence.unverified: compiler identity, flags, model and link line not yet confirmed by a probe receipt
config_evidence.verified: compiler probe receipt under this exact profile

roundtrip_status.note: per-source and per-cell values aggregate the selected profiles; all selected cases are currently not_attempted

phase_status.not_started: required phase represented explicitly so it cannot be accidentally excluded

cell_axis.source_feature: C construct present and exercised in the witness source
cell_axis.emitted_pattern: specific binary mechanism the compiler must emit; never inferred from source text
cell_axis.boundary: compiler-generated helper or matched library call boundary

signed/unsigned char arithmetic and shifts, short/ushort/int arithmetic, uint rotate via (a<<1)|(a>>15) exercising bit-15 boundary, long add and ulong sub as multiword ops, pointer-return selection over char arrays; float/double remain commented out (FPU excluded); checks 1-13

sources.proposal: Signed/unsigned char at 127/128/255 boundaries, explicit truncation casts, promotion into int comparisons; scalar_widths already covers generic byte ops, this adds only the boundary inputs

Unsigned long add/sub carry across the 65535 low-word boundary (e.g. 0x0000FFFF+1, 0x00010000-1, borrows); in-range signed long only, no signed overflow; desired emitted mechanism is adc/sbb carry propagation

Long/unsigned long multiply, divide and modulo on in-range values; emitted mechanism (helper call vs inline multiword sequence) is unverified and must be observed per compiler; helper calls count toward calls.compiler_helpers
Unsigned long left/right shifts with counts below width including the 15/16/17 boundary; signed long shifts avoided where implementation-defined; multiword shift emission recorded per compiler

Dense consecutive case range (e.g. 0..11) sized to plausibly elicit an indirect jump table per compiler; the cell is only an emitted witness if binary/IR inspection under the exact profile shows table dispatch -- a compare-chain emission still covers flow.switch but leaves emitted.switch_jump_table unverified
&& and || chains where later operands are calls with observable global side effects, proving evaluation order and short-circuit suppression; existing sources only have pure-load conditions
Bounded variadic callee using stdarg.h with sentinel-terminated scalar arguments of mixed width; checks caller cleanup and argument transport, not a printf port
Depth-bounded recursion (e.g. recursive gcd or depth-limited sum) with a base case observed through globals; frame depth kept small and deterministic

Explicit far/near qualified pointers and functions under the small model: far data read/write through a far pointer, far call and far function pointer transport, segment preservation; run under small and also the large subset to contrast defaults
Struct containing a nested struct, an array member and a pointer member; field addressing through both object and pointer; layout probe evidence recorded separately, padding not an oracle

Union with byte/word/long members and a union nested in a struct; same-member store/load plus the per-compiler overlay pattern already used by enum_union_overlay; extends coverage beyond the 2-byte case
